episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Horrified bystanders watch as otherworldly beasts chase down and kill a man in broad daylight. Jung Jin Soo declares that only sinners are sent to hell.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: The New Truth offers a sizable payment to Park Jungja, a condemned woman, in exchange for the right to live-broadcast the moment her fate is decided.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Addressing a stunned world, Jinsu preaches righteousness. Detective Jin Kyunghun searches for his missing daughter. The Arrowhead targets Min Hyejin.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Bae Youngjae follows his co-worker to a fishing dock, where he witnesses a terrifying sight. The Prophet Angel appears in an unthinkable place.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: A despairing Youngjae tracks down a man who he thinks might have answers. The New Truth catches wind of a mysterious organization with its own agenda.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: With detrimental information hanging over its head, The New Truth scrambles to protect its power by preventing the public from learning the truth.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: After a series of visions, Jinsu finds himself mysteriously resurrected. Realizing he's losing power, Kim Jeongchil agrees to work with the government.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: While in hiding, Kyunghun and his daughter suddenly come under attack. Meanwhile, the New Truth accelerates their announcement plan.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Jeongchil manipulates Jungja to carry out the New Will. As Jinsu learns more about Cheon Sehyeong, he begins to form his escape plan.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Jinsu puts forward his plot to come face to face with Jungja. However, Hyejin decides to carry out her own rescue plan to retrieve Jungja for Sodo.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: As Hyejin, Jinsu and Jeongchil all try to grab ahold of Jungja, Senior Secretary Lee plays her own game on the sidelines — but chaos arises everywhere.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Jinsu confronts Jungja, desperately searching for answers. But as disorder unfolds, will Hyejin be able to get Jungja to safety before it's too late?
